content: Next sentence prediction has been used in skip-thought vectors BIBREF33. There are two differences. First, each segment in their model only has one sentence; second, they use this task to pre-train an encoder rather than an entire seq2seq model. BIBREF2 introduced a task named next sentence prediction (NSP), which is different from this task. NSP is a classification task, but NSG is a generation task, which intends to pre-train a generation model.
